u2net.notes: U2-Net salient-object segmentation, 320x320 input. Weights as distributed by the rembg project (MIT).

u2netp.notes: Small U2-Net variant: faster, rougher edges.

realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan.notes: Real-ESRGAN ncnn Vulkan build with the realesrgan-x4plus, realesrgan-x4plus-anime, and realesr-animevideov3 models. Needs a Vulkan device; a software one (Mesa lavapipe) works but is slow.
